reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in your DM and told him to start with Pree (Priyanka Sundaram, psundaram@pemberline.com). Tansley Parcel is her account: his own Central territory plan calls it "Pree's biggest account," and she ran the last Tansley Parcel incident.

What else I told him:
- **Customer contact:** The only one I can find is Lev Arkadin. He came up in #central-team and in the Tansley Parcel incident channel. There's no phone number for him anywhere Hollis has access to, so he'll need to get it from Pree.
- **No set escalation route:** I found no named escalation contact, on-call number or open Tansley Parcel ticket in anything Hollis can access.
- **Incident channel:** #inc-tansley-carrier-api was closed on 2025-09-03. If this is another outage, he could reopen it or start a new incident room with Pree and Tobias.
- **Logging it with support:** He should write "Tansley Parcel" in full, not "TP." He set that rule himself in #central-team so the wrong on-call doesn't get paged for Tansleigh Packaging.

I only used what Hollis can see himself: his channels, public files and the directory. I didn't read Pree's DM with me, and I didn't search messages.
